A1.justification: Both PDFs are readable and describe the same LaSt-ViT/LazyStrike work. Their text, equations, tables and figures support comparison. The supplied v1 includes supplementary Sections 8–13; v2 ends after its references and omits that material, despite retaining appendix references.

before.justification: v1 reports original ImageNet probes, LazyStrike benchmark results and ablations in Sections 4–6, plus supplementary comparisons and qualitative analyses.

after.justification: v2 retains the original experiments and results in Sections 4–6 and Tables 1–9, including segmentation, localization and pooling ablations.

M1.justification: Sections 5.1–5.2 retain the same frequency filtering, stability score, channel-wise Top-K aggregation, vote count and downstream procedures. Omission of supplementary implementation details does not establish an algorithm change.

E1.justification: The reported coverage remains ImageNet, six semantic-segmentation benchmarks, OV-COCO/OV-LVIS and VOC07/VOC12/COCO object discovery. The omitted supplementary comparisons and visualizations concern retained tasks; no replacement training corpus or distinct evaluation scenario is reported.

E2.justification: v2 omits the broader OV-COCO comparison in v1 Table 12, losing comparisons with eleven additional detectors, including RegionCLIP, ViLD, Detic, BARON, EdaDet and RO-ViT. Comparator membership in Tables 1–9 is unchanged. The newly cited inference-time register method is discussed but not evaluated.

E3.justification: Matched experiments retain their stated ImageNet selection, backbones, masking procedures, patch-size/window-attention interventions and Top-K settings. No revised experimental setting is reported. The missing supplementary recipes and metric instructions constitute lost documentation, rather than evidence of changed protocols.

E4.justification: The main masking, patch-size, window-attention and pooling ablations remain. However, v2 omits supplementary Sections 10–12 and Figures 8–14, removing substantial diagnostic evidence about norm stratification, patch-score/feature-norm relationships and foreground/background behavior across supervision types.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run counts, seeds, confidence intervals or formal significance tests. Retained tables and figures use the same reporting conventions; the score standard deviation used for mask thresholding is unchanged and is not experimental uncertainty reporting.

E6.justification: Tables 1–9 and the main plotted results are unchanged. v2 removes supplementary comparison entries, such as EdaDet's 37.8 and RO-ViT's 33.0 novel-category AP50 in Table 12, together with the norm-stratification and qualitative results in Figures 8–14. LaSt-ViT's 33.3/39.1 OV-COCO scores remain in Table 5; no same-setting performance improvement is reported.

T1.justification: The architectural definitions, Patch Score/PiB definitions and method equations (1)–(8) are unchanged. The omitted supplement contains implementation descriptions and qualitative hypotheses, not additional formal propositions or proofs.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction's contributions and conclusion retain the same claims about lazy aggregation, coarse supervision/global dependencies, selective foreground aggregation and improvements across twelve benchmarks. The missing supporting material does not narrow these claims.

C2.justification: v2 omits substantial supplementary interpretation: the local-crop explanation for DINO-v1's exception, the accumulated-artifact/uneven-gradient hypothesis, and the qualification that feature norm need not track global semantics. Comparisons of ConvNet boundary emphasis versus ViT foreground aggregation and discussion of other sequence models also disappear. The central main-text interpretation remains.

D1.justification: v1 Section 8 and Tables 10–11 provide training recipes, initialization/code-base information and evaluation instructions that are absent from v2. Lost details include LAION-400M fine-tuning, the 0.64B-sample text-supervised budget, label-supervised batch size 4096 and 100 epochs, optimizer schedules, and coarse-segmentation thresholding. The project URL remains unchanged.

R1.justification: Section 2 adds a focused discussion of Vision Transformers Don't Need Trained Registers and distinguishes LazyStrike's training-time approach from inference-time activation editing. Background citations expand, while references associated solely with the omitted supplement disappear. The main positioning relative to Registers and CLIP artifact corrections remains intact.

P1.justification: v2 removes the entire supplementary structure covering implementation, additional comparisons, diagnostic analyses and discussion. It adds an acknowledgments section and marks Yizhou Yu as a corresponding author. Apart from the related-work extension, the retained main narrative is largely verbatim; the substantial change is structural deletion rather than extensive rewriting.

P2.justification: Supplementary Tables 10–12 and Figures 8–14 are absent from v2, removing training tables, a broader comparison table and extensive diagnostic galleries. Main Figures 1–7 and Tables 1–9 retain their content but undergo layout reflow, including relocation of Table 1 and Figure 3.

improvement.justification: The focused related-work addition improves positioning, but v2 omits the detailed training recipes, broader detector comparison and substantial diagnostic evidence supplied by v1's supplement. It retains the same claims and results, along with references to the absent appendix. For the supplied PDFs, this substantially weakens reproducibility and evidential completeness without compensating methodological or empirical gains.
